title: First and last character
prompt: Return the first character of the text joined to the last one. "hello" gives "ho". The text always has at least one character.
hints: Characters can be picked out by position with square brackets.
The last position is length minus 1.

docs.name: text[i]
docs.what: The character at position i, starting from 0.

docs.name: text.length()
docs.what: Returns how many characters the string has.

docs.name: text + text
docs.what: Joins two strings into one. Numbers must be turned into text first.
